These three Office files were generated for the personal-files test corpus on 26 October 2026. They contain only the fictional Quists of Gloamshire and explicitly identify themselves as invented demo records.

The files exercise ordinary application-produced DOCX, XLSX and PPTX packaging, including UTF-8 byte-order marks, tables, cached spreadsheet formulas, relationship IDs, and presentation slide ordering. Their text is tested through the same bounded media extractor used for uploaded files.
